_doc: Point-in-time retrospective. Every input was public on as_of; see sources. Hindsight lives only in outcome.json.
methodology: house v2 (EPP-distance adjustment), 6-section format; retro method r2: scenario inputs derived from dated facts by frozen rules (retro/README.md); pharmaceutical signals

pit_profile.why: 'is a global biopharmaceutical company whose mission is to discover, develop and deliver innovative medicines that help patients prevail over serious diseases.' (FY2021 10-K, Item 7); 'We face intense competition from other manufacturers and expect to see increasing market penetration of lower-priced generic products.' (Item 1A heading); 'We could lose market exclusivity of a product earlier than expected.' (Item 1A heading); 'We depend on several key products for most of our revenues, cash flows and earnings.' (Item 1A heading)

BEAR.desc: EPS -22.1%/yr (worst year FY12-FY18 ex-FY15 ex-FY17, capped at 0%); P/E to its 10th pct

BASE.desc: EPS +-3.9%/yr (FY22 guide + margin + buyback); P/E at its 10-yr ex-FY15 ex-FY17 ex-FY19 ex-FY20 ex-FY21 median

BULL.desc: EPS +17.2%/yr (FY12-FY18 ex-FY15 ex-FY17 CAGR); P/E holds its 75th pct

XBULL.desc: EPS +48.6%/yr (best 2-yr run FY12-FY18 ex-FY15 ex-FY17); P/E at its 90th pct

summary: BMY (retrospective, 2022-09-30) ◎ ACCUMULATE — Ratio B 0.76x (53.6% downside to Bear $33 / +70.2% upside to Bull $121) | Adj composite 2.21 vs market 2.27: gap -0.06 [FAIRLY VALUED] | +18% above the EPP floor $60 (21x FY22E $2.86) | Conservative 2-yr case: +10.9% total (+5.4%/yr) | At 24.9x FY22E the 15% hurdle price $94 sits between the BASE and BULL cases; U.S. revenues +11.9% in Q2 2022, forward revenues -0.8% (FY22 revenue guide); no disruption theme has dated evidence.
